answer_1.quote: This work analyzes multiple sequence-to-sequence models that were used to generate short company descriptions from Wikipedia articles.

answer_2.quote: They evaluated the system performance on the test set of their Wikipedia company corpus using five automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: the humans assessed the criteria information coverage, information redundancy, semantic adequacy and grammatical correctness on a 5-point Likert scale.
